subject: The one mistake 90% of users make on race day
preview_text: It's not about picking the winner. It's about avoiding this single, costly error that drains your credits.
body_paragraphs: You know that feeling when you're scanning the racecard, you see a horse with decent odds, and you think 'maybe'? That's the exact moment you're about to waste a prediction. I've watched thousands of users do it. They fire off a pick based on a hunch, a name they like, or a jockey they remember from last season. Their credits vanish before the big races even start.

Here's the tiny trick that separates the punters who cash in from those who just cash out: Never use a prediction on a race where the AI's top pick has a confidence score below 70. Sounds simple, right? It's brutal discipline. It means sometimes you sit out a race. But it forces you to only play when the data screams value. This one filter turns random guessing into strategic betting. You stop chasing longshots and start backing proven probabilities.

This is why we built the Confidence Score right on the main racecard screen. It's not just a number—it's your gatekeeper. Before you tap 'Analyze', glance at that score. If it's glowing green at 70+, you're in business. The AI has crunched the jockey form, the track conditions, the weight—everything—and given you a solid signal. Below that? The race is too chaotic, even for our algorithms. Save your bullet.

Open the app right now. Don't even make a pick. Just scroll to today's races and look for the first race with a top pick confidence score of 70 or higher. See how it feels to have a clear, data-backed 'go' signal. That's how you build a bankroll. P.S. The real secret? Premium users with unlimited predictions can afford to be even more ruthless with this rule. They wait for the 80+ scores and clean up.
